notes: Your licence, and who it belongs to. Every control panel now shows Licensed to your name and email quietly in the corner - operator screens only, never the output pages, so it can never reach your stream. Licence keys can now also be withdrawn if one is shared publicly, in which case the watermark returns the next time that copy is opened; a copy already running is never interrupted, and if the app cannot reach us, or you are offline at a venue, your licence keeps working exactly as normal. Also: Copy all output links and Copy all control links now include the name of each link, so a pasted list says which address is which.
